terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Rules for using dobreprinty.pl and for placing and fulfilling orders.

blocks.text: The dobreprinty.pl service ("DobrePrinty", "Seller") is operated by {{owner}}, {{address}}, as an unregistered business activity (Art. 5 of the Polish Entrepreneurs' Law). Contact: {{email}}. The Seller is not a VAT payer.

items: Customer – a person or business placing an order.
Consumer – a Customer who is a natural person ordering for purposes unrelated to their business or profession.
Order – a print job placed on the site and paid for by the Customer.
You place an order in the product configurator. The contract is concluded once the payment is received.
Prices are in Polish złoty (PLN) and are final. The delivery cost is shown before payment.
Printing may be done by a subcontractor (partner print shop). The Seller is responsible to the Customer for fulfilling the order.
The Customer provides the print file and is responsible for its content: text, data, spelling and layout.
The Customer confirms they have the right to use the content (including copyright and trademarks) and that the content is lawful.
We check files only technically (format, resolution, bleed). We do not correct content.
We print according to the file approved by the Customer.
We may refuse to print unlawful content. In that case we refund the full payment.

blocks.text: The Customer may order a paid test print (proof) or technical file preparation. Only a test print guarantees accurate colour reproduction.
Payments are processed by Stripe (including BLIK, card, Przelewy24, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Stripe sends the proof of purchase to the email address given in the order.

items: The production time shown for a product is approximate. It starts when the payment is received and the file is approved. It does not include delivery time.
We ship by courier or to a parcel locker.
Check the parcel on receipt. Report visible damage to the carrier and take photos.

blocks.text: The following differences are standard in printing and are not defects:

items: colour differences between the screen and the print, and between print runs,
cutting shift of up to ±2 mm,
slight differences in paper shade and texture,
for large runs, a quantity difference of up to 5%; we charge for the quantity actually delivered.
Send complaints to {{email}}. Describe the problem and attach photos.
We reply within 14 days.
We resolve an accepted complaint by reprinting the defective part. If that is not possible, we refund proportionally via Stripe.
Complaints do not cover the tolerances in section 8 or errors in the Customer's file (section 4).
Consumers keep all rights granted by law. These terms do not limit them.

blocks.text: Prints are made to the Customer's individual order. Therefore Consumers have no right to withdraw from the contract (Art. 38(3) of the Polish Consumer Rights Act). An order can be cancelled free of charge until production starts – write to {{email}}.

Towards Customers who are not Consumers: the Seller's liability is limited to the amount paid for the given order and does not cover lost profits; statutory warranty is excluded. This does not apply to damage caused intentionally.
The Privacy Policy describes how we process personal data.

Polish law applies. This does not deprive Consumers of the protection granted by the law of their country. The Seller may change these terms; orders placed earlier are governed by the terms in force on the day of the order.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We explain what personal data we collect, why we need it and what rights you have.

blocks.text: The controller of your personal data is {{owner}}, operator of the dobreprinty.pl service. Contact: {{email}}.
We process the data you provide when registering an account, placing an order and using our services:

items: first name, surname, e-mail, phone number, delivery address and invoice details
print data (graphic files), solely for the purpose of fulfilling the order
technical data: IP address, session identifier, browser data
order fulfilment and after-sales service
payment settlement and tax obligations
complaint handling and customer contact
analytics and improving the service (anonymised data)

sections.heading: 4. Sharing data with partner print shops

blocks.text: To fulfil an order, we share print files and the delivery address with the partner print shop and the carrier – only as far as necessary. Payments are processed by Stripe.

items: access to your data, its rectification and erasure
restriction of processing and objection
data portability
lodging a complaint with the President of the Polish Data Protection Office (UODO)

blocks.text: We use essential cookies (login, cart). Analytics cookies (PostHog) are enabled only with your consent.
